notes: Both definitions and both examples match p.4 and p.30.

question: Why do models struggle to use documents placed in the middle of the prompt?
notes: U-shaped curve, primacy/recency, not robustly using long contexts (p.2, p.11). Explains what happens rather than why, and says so.

question: How can a model reduce factual errors by deciding on demand whether to retrieve?
